prerequisites: Physical fundamentals (thermodynamics, dynamics, statics, and kinematics)
Knowledge of the system of units and fundamental magnitudes: Force, flow rate, pressure, power, mass, work, enthalpy, entropy, etc.
Very elementary concepts of fluids (air and liquids) such as: pressure, flow rate, force, temperature, angular velocity, control volume, mass flow, etc.
Basic PC usage (word processor, spreadsheet, file manipulation, etc.)

learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic characteristics of different types of thermal machines.
Know the operation of the most common thermal machines and the physical-technical principles that justify it.
Know the basic components of a thermal machine and their characteristics.
Be able to select the most suitable thermal machine for a specific application.
Be able to plan the maintenance of a thermal machine.
Be able to assess the profitability of using a thermal machine in a given application.
Problem-solving ability: Ability to identify, analyze, and define the significant elements that constitute a problem to solve it rigorously.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1. Reciprocating engines: Types and operation.
Topic 2. Components and mechanisms of reciprocating engines.
Topic 3. Thermodynamic processes in internal combustion engines. Otto, Diesel and Mixed cycles.
Topic 4. The intake and combustion process. Supercharging.
Topic 5. Characteristic values, efficiency, and characteristic curves of thermal engines.
Topic 6. Test benches for internal combustion engines.
BLOCK II: Turbomachinery, boilers and combustion chambers.
Topic 11. Steam turbines and thermal power plants.
teaching_methods: Use of Virtual Classroom as teaching support

assessment_methods.method: Final written test evaluating reports/assignments/projects/in-person classes, etc., and practical tutor reports (if applicable)

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, it is necessary to pass both parts with at least 5 out of 10 points in each of them. Class attendance will not be compulsory. The Single Final Assessment and Extraordinary Assessment will be the same as the ordinary call. For competencies CTEM3 and CT7, it will be necessary to possess these competencies to pass the subject.
